records.rationale: The finding is correct. Looking at lines 879-884 in the diff, when `enable_advanced_features` is True and `cursor.offset < 0`, the code sets `start_offset = cursor.offset` (a negative value) and then does `results = list(queryset[start_offset:stop])`. Django QuerySet slicing does not support negative indexes - it will raise an AssertionError or similar error.
